PowerSupplyMetrics.description: The PowerSupplyMetrics schema contains definitions for the metrics of a power supply.
PowerSupplyMetrics.longDescription: This resource shall represent the metrics of a power supply for a Redfish implementation.

FanSpeedsPercent.longDescription: This property shall contain the fan speeds, in percent units, for this power supply.

InputPowerWatts.description: The input power (W) for this power supply.
InputPowerWatts.longDescription: This property shall contain the input power, in watt units, for this power supply.

PrimarySensor.description: The primary sensor for this power supply.
PrimarySensor.longDescription: This property shall contain a link to a resource of type Sensor that reports for this power supply.

title: #PowerSupplyMetrics.v1_1_0.PowerSupplyMetrics
